channel.title: AMNI-SCIENT Updates
channel.description: What shipped, what it means, why it matters.

item.title: Bolts torque & preload page — sharper copy
item.description: Torque-to-preload with documented K, yield and scatter checks, less lecture. Shipping the human pass on /calc/bolts.html.

item.title: Listed Braid, Calc, and Adam where makers look
item.description: Soft note — Braid, Amni-Calc, and Adam now have Indie Hackers product pages and SaaSHub listings. Same tools, findable in one more place.

item.title: Cutting the lecture walls on Calc pages
item.description: Human pass on the module pages — keep equations and one worked example, cut the syllabus voice. Shipping carefully.

item.title: Qwen3-8B path for Adam — in progress
item.description: Loader work toward a Qwen3-8B GF17 atex bake. Path in progress — no bpw win and no quality claim yet.

item.title: CLI seats and what stays on your machine
item.description: Braid’s privacy story is boring on purpose — your CLIs, your keys, licence check only.

item.title: Adam GF17 atex: honest baseline
item.description: Granite GF17 atex bake bills ~4.6 bpw all-in. That is the baseline — not a 1 bpw win, not near-lossless.

item.title: Bolts, fatigue, springs — notes that stuck
item.description: A tighter pass on the modules I actually use — preload/torque, fatigue criteria on one FoS shape, spring rates that match the book.

item.title: Dogfooding Amni-Browse on NeverSSL and HN
item.description: After the Linux paint path landed, I pointed the omnibox at plain HTTP and a busy site — boring checks, useful failures.

item.title: Braid is still $10/mo and still yours
item.description: Soft product note — eight seats, the CLIs you already pay for, licence check only. No token resale story.

item.title: Amni-Browse paints on Linux
item.description: WebKitGTK finally packs into the GTK window, with a sibling omnibox and Ctrl+L — alpha, but the page is no longer a blank white box.

item.title: What landed in the Amni-Calc WASM suite
item.description: Mid-August polish notes on the in-browser engineering kernels — beams, bolts, springs, seals, fatigue load-line, and the rest of the F-row fixes.

item.title: Grok Remote is easier to live with
item.description: Desktop can see every chat again, long-press reacts without a stuck bar, and cancelling a queued message puts the text back in the box.

item.title: Updates now live on amni-scient.com
item.description: A dated ship log when something you can actually use lands.

item.title: All eight Braid seats are live
item.description: ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, and OpenCode join Claude, Grok, Gemini, and a local seat at the table. Braid still drives the subscriptions you already pay for.
